newsitem.title: USA: Xerox Corp completes sale of Coregis unit.
newsitem.headline: Xerox Corp completes sale of Coregis unit.

text.p: Xerox Corp said Monday it completed the sale of Coregis Group Inc, a Talegen subsidiary, to General Electric Co's GE Capital Services for about $375 million in cash plus the repayment of $75 million in debt.
Xerox said the sale is part of the corporation's previously announced strategy to disengage from financial services and redeploy capital into its core document processing business.
An agreement for the sale of Coregis was announced January 23.
Coregis is based in Chicago and has approximately 470 employees, Xerox said.
Coregis writes commercial property and casualty insurance programs for public entities, selected classes of licensed or certified professionals and other specific market niches throughout the U.S.
